load_and_preprocess_data: load and preprocess computational and experimental electrocatalysis data from CSV files with XRD matching and energy aggregation
get_and_apply_xrf_mapping: apply XRF composition mapping from XRF data to experimental data and filter out null entries
get_production_rate: convert faradaic efficiency and current density to a production rate in mol per cm squared per second
get_constant_V: interpolate experimental data to a fixed applied potential using log-linear interpolation for Faradaic efficiency columns
add_cv_categories: add leave-one-out and leave-one-composition-out cross-validation category columns to a dataframe for ML training
